content.title: Tour of Flanders Sportive (We Ride Flanders) edition 2026
content.text: Tour of Flanders Sportive (We Ride Flanders) 2026 was road bike cycling event category cyclosportive in Belgium, Flanders. The edition Tour of Flanders Sportive (We Ride Flanders) 2026 is part of the circuit Cycling Monuments and took place on Saturday 04 April 2026 with departure in Oudenaarde, provincie Oost-Vlaanderen, Flanders. Tour of Flanders Sportive (We Ride Flanders) is offering 4 routes (242, 179, 144, 80 km) for road bike Organizer: Ride one day before the pros ride your Tour of Flanders with the same iconic slopes and the same legendary cobblestone lanes. routes - courses road bike 242 km 179 km 144 km 80 km road bike Brugge Oudenaarde 242 km / 150 mi road bike Oudenaarde, Grote Markt 179 km / 111 mi road bike Oudenaarde, Grote Markt 144 km / 89 mi road bike Oudenaarde, Grote Markt 80 km / 50 mi Add your comment Sign in to post a comment Commentsselectselectenglishdutchfrenchspanishitalian Batti StradaSign in to replyRegistrations Tour of Flanders Sportive (We Ride Flanders) 2026 open on Oct. 7th.
